elements.text: E-412: the battery management system lost contact with one cell group. Switch the bike off and on. If the error stays, test the battery with the dealer service tool.
E-417: the battery is too hot to charge. Unplug the fast charger and let the battery cool to room temperature before charging again.
E-447: the fast charger reported a voltage it doesn't support. Check that the charger is the approved T-7 fast charger.
E-471: the battery is too cold to charge. Bring the bike indoors and wait until the battery warms to room temperature before charging.
E-714: the rear light circuit is open. Check the light connector under the rear rack.
